title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Sonic the Hedgehog?
description: The Beetle's designer, the Mercedes racing team, two racing legends, a seven-time champion, a talk-show host and Jim Carrey connect Adolf Hitler to Sonic the Hedgehog.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Sonic the Hedgehog?
fun_fact: Alfred Neubauer, pictured with Porsche in 1924, is credited with inventing pit signals: he was the first team boss to signal his drivers with flags and boards from the pit wall.
research_note: Commons only had a tiny copy of the famous Beetle-model photo, so a larger scan of the same Hoffmann photo came from Santa Clara University's exhibit; from there, motor racing leads to Lewis Hamilton, and Sonic comes in through a real 2020 premiere photo of the costumed Sonic with Jim Carrey.

links.line: Ferdinand Porsche showed Hitler a model of his new people's car, the Volkswagen Beetle.

image.file: File:Auto-ontwerper Ferdinand Porsche (rechts) en Alfred Neubauer met een racewagen,race-auto op, SFA007000597.jpg

links.line: In 1924, Porsche took a race car to Sicily with Alfred Neubauer, the father of pit signals.

image.file: File:Training voor Grote Prijs van Nederland op Zandvoort, leider van de Mercedesploe, Bestanddeelnr 907-1856.jpg

links.line: By 1955, Neubauer ran the Mercedes team, and his star driver was Fangio.

image.file: File:Grote Prijs van Nederland Zandvoort. De winnaar J. M. Fangio (links) wordt gefel, Bestanddeelnr 907-1900.jpg

links.line: Two days later, Fangio won that race, and teammate Stirling Moss congratulated him.

image.file: File:Bob Ives, Lewis Hamilton. Joe Ives, Stirling Moss.jpg

links.line: Decades later, Moss posed with a teenage Lewis Hamilton, a future seven-time champion.
In 2022, Sir Lewis told Jimmy Kimmel about being knighted.
In 2017, a heavily bearded Jim Carrey sat down with Kimmel.
At the 2020 premiere, Jim Carrey posed with Sonic.
